title: Photo Speaks My Short Script
tests: Tests photo-based talking-head generation with an exact spoken script, identity preservation, and synchronized mouth movement.

exact_text.text: Hi everyone! Thanks for stopping by. I can't wait to show you what's new.
exact_text.read_as: Hi everyone, thanks for stopping by. I can't wait to show you what's new.

judge.summary: The square talking portrait preserves the woman's appearance and delivers the complete script without captions, though precise lip-sync and voice quality cannot be verified from the supplied evidence.

must_haves.item: The speaker is recognizably the curly-haired woman in the attached portrait, not a replacement presenter.
must_haves.why: The facial features, curly hair, gray sweater, and park setting remain consistent with the attached portrait.

must_haves.item: The complete supplied script is spoken exactly, with no extra spoken words.
must_haves.why: The supplied speech transcript contains every requested word with no additions; the punctuation difference does not change the spoken wording.

must_haves.item: Her mouth visibly moves in sync with the speech rather than remaining a still photo under narration.
must_haves.why: The sampled frames show distinct open, rounded, and closed mouth shapes, establishing animation rather than a still photograph, but they do not establish precise synchronization with the audio.

must_haves.item: The result is one square, 8-second video with audible, friendly female English speech.
must_haves.why: One square video is shown, its duration is reported as eight seconds, and the transcript and audio peak confirm audible English speech; the voice's female character and friendly delivery cannot be judged without hearing it.
No captions or other text appear in any of the supplied output frames.
